definitions: An area, often a border area between two countries or factions, from which military forces, operations, or installations are prohibited.
A specific area in a network that is accessible from the internet but is isolated from the internal local area network (LAN) to provide an additional layer of security.
examples: The Demilitarized Zone between North and South Korea is heavily guarded.
The network administrator set up a DMZ for the public-facing web server.
